g.text: Single RTX 4090 | Qwen2.5-7B | 128 output tokens per background request | Mean and sample SD, 5 repeats

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: For each background request: TPOT = (last token arrival - first token arrival) / 127. Average requests within each trial, then five repeats.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: Only background decode requests contribute to these curves. Interferer TTFT and prefill model wall time are separate measurements.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: Adapted workload: independent 128-token histories; full recomputes 17,408 tokens, append computes 1,024 with 16,384 cached. Batch 0 has no TPOT.
